lines.text: Many learners say: I am angry on my brother.
Better: I am angry with my brother.
With! She is angry with me.

data.wrong: I am angry on my brother.
data.right: I am angry with my brother.

native.tip: С angry ставь “with”: “I am angry with my brother.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I am angry on my brother”? 😅 По-русски «сержусь на брата», и хочется “on”, но в английском нужно “with.” Правильно: “I am angry with my brother.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “with.” С человеком — angry with. Напиши своё предложение с “I am angry with.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: With angry, use “with”: “I am angry with my brother.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I am angry on my brother”? 😅 The Russian phrase is literally “angry on,” so “on” slips in, but in English you need “with.” Correct: “I am angry with my brother.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
